plain: Full of strong feeling or eagerness

webster.text: Hot; burning; that causes a sensation of burning; as, ardent spirits, that is, distilled spirits; an ardent fever.

more.text: Warm, applied to the passions and affections; passionate; affectionate; much engaged; zealous; as, ardent love or vows; ardent zeal.

example.quote: It is observed that select corps may be formed, composed of the young and ardent, who may be rendered subservient to the views of arbitrary power.
